0.7.1: New app and tray icon, drawn by an artist friend.
Updating is clearer and quicker: "Updating to x.y.z" or "Update failed" right away, a notice in the tray, and the switch takes seconds. The "Update to" label in the helper now works when clicked.
Behind the scenes: the app was reorganized into separate parts so new features are easier to add. Nothing should look different; tell us if something does.
0.7.0: Monster album: every monster as ?, greyed out (seen) or caught. Your first kill of each one takes a photo and adds a diary entry with a catch phrase; bosses get their own. Tray > Open monster album, or 👾 Album in the diary.
Training cost panel (off by default, Settings or tray): MP, potions and mesos per kill and per hour on your map, and what it takes to level up; EXP/hr counts your party's share apart.
Diary: a camera button in the helper's corner for a picture any time, sharper character close-ups, level-up pictures at the right moment, and you can delete entries.
0.6.4: Updates now wait until you've stopped playing for a minute before restarting the app (one restarted mid-play).
Fixed: a new level digit could be read as the wrong level, which made the app ignore your Stat window.
0.6.3: Friends hangout: everyone with your code shows in a Friends list on the party panel (level, EXP, map, HP), on any map, no in-game party needed.
Start menu and desktop shortcuts, and the tracker now always starts with the app (and comes back if it stops).
Fixed: map names could break after an update.
0.6.2: Fixed: skill levels like Improved MP Recovery could stay unreadable on a new install, so the MP regen slot didn't show. Open your Stat window once, then the Skill window, and it fills in.
0.6.1: Fixed: on a new install the skill bar never appeared and MP regen wasn't tracked. HP/MP now read right away, and opening the Stat window once teaches the app every number it needs.
0.6.0: Party panel over the game: bigger HP bars for everyone in your party, read from the game's party box (shows when you're in a party).
Party link: partners who also run this app see each other's exact HP, MP and EXP. Set the server and party code in Settings > Internet > Party link.
0.5.2: The MP/HP recovery countdown always uses the skill's own rhythm (every 10 seconds); the screen only tells it when each tick lands.
0.5.1: MP/HP recovery countdown fixed after a level-up, and it now follows ticks that your playing pushes back (it waits at 0 for a late tick).
The number under the MP slot shows the size of the latest tick (+12 standing still, +9 moving).
0.5.0: The skill bar is now on by default. Drag it anywhere; right-click to lock it so clicks go to the game.
Right-click a skill on the bar to remove it, and "Add back" to bring it back.
After an update, this card tells you what's new.
0.4.0: Skill bar over the game: measured MP/HP regen with a countdown to the next tick, and casts left for each skill.
Exact HP and MP from the status bar.
Screen checks per second now default to 2.
0.3.0: Your stats, skill levels and channel are remembered per character from the game's windows.
